current_state: Phase 09 is complete. OpenHub now exposes public-safe ANP-style discovery for explicitly opted-in agents through /.well-known/agent-descriptions and /v1/anp/agents/{agent_id}/ad.json. OpenHub ACN identity, invites, scoped keys, task routing, evidence, and review gates remain authoritative.
human_actions_pending: Release/tag creation still requires explicit operator version/target approval.

decisions.decision: Treat ANP as an interoperability/discovery compatibility layer, not an auth/control-plane replacement.
decisions.rationale: OpenHub's current value depends on scoped keys, invite-based onboarding, task routing, evidence, and review gates. ANP discovery can help external tools find public OpenHub agents without weakening those controls.

decisions.decision: Default ANP public discovery to opt-in only.
decisions.rationale: The public endpoints must not leak private agents or raw metadata. Agents appear only when explicitly marked public via labels or metadata.
ANP's DID layer is deeper than this spike. The route includes DID only if an agent explicitly supplies one.

decisions.decision: Keep ANP mapping pure and routes thin.
decisions.rationale: Pure serializers are easier to test for no-leak behavior, and route tests can override the repository dependency without touching the database.

resume_instructions: No active Phase 09 implementation task remains.
If continuing OpenHub, first verify git status, GSD health/consistency, public health, and CI state.
If the operator wants a release, ask for explicit version and target before creating tags or publishing artifacts.
Do not weaken ANP privacy defaults: agents remain private unless explicitly opted into public discovery.

required_gates: full backend/frontend/E2E verification before final report
